name: contextweave
description: Two deployable packages plus the docs that describe them. backend/ is the mock API and its seeds; frontend/ is the console. This root installs nothing and orchestrates both.

scripts.preflight: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run verify:sigv4 && npm run verify:export && npm run check-docs

//independent: No npm workspaces on purpose. Workspaces hoist one lockfile and one node_modules to the root, which is the opposite of what these two packages are for: each installs, builds and deploys on its own, and the backend must be shippable without pulling react. The cost is that this root cannot 'npm i' for both — install in each package — and the scripts below delegate with --prefix rather than run tools the root does not have.
